segments.text: Every multi- aent handoff is paste and hope the whole plan into each sub aent.
No idea which one read it. Waggle replaces that with a 30 byt token. Each sub aent resolves it into its own view and gps the slice it needs. So the
artifact never travels. Every read is counted so you catch a sub aent that bluffed before you trust it. Fix the plan. One revoke reaches all of them.
It's MCP native. One config line.
